localChanges: Imports of hls.js modules that are not copied (errors, events, config, hls, logger, codecs, loader/level-key, types/transmuxer|track|buffer|loader) point at Otter's own src/otter/shims.ts with the same names and shapes; '.js' extensions added (NodeNext).
Build-time defines __USE_M2TS_ADVANCED_CODECS__ / __USE_IFRAMES__ became constants in shims.ts (true / false).

SAMPLE-AES removed: sample-aes.ts not copied, demuxSampleAes/decrypt deleted, the three SAMPLE-AES stream types log and skip instead of falling through. AC-3 demuxer not copied; parseAC3PES is a stub (unreachable: typeSupported.ac3 is always false).

utils/mp4-tools.ts: only the box type table, RemuxerTrackIdConfig, uint read/write, appendUint8Array, decodeUtf8UserData, parseSEIMessageFromNALu and discardEPB; utf8 via TextDecoder instead of @svta/cml-id3.
types/demuxer.ts: enum MetadataSchema -> const object + type (erasableSyntaxOnly); fMP4 passthrough types (InitData, ParsedSampleData) replaced by unknown; demuxSampleAes removed from Demuxer.

Strict TypeScript: non-null assertions on index reads (scripts/vendor-strictify.ts, mechanical), optional members typed '| undefined' (exactOptionalPropertyTypes), explicit 'return undefined', override modifier, catch values cast to Error, MP4.box spread instead of apply. Behaviour unchanged; tests in vendor/hls.js/test.

Host APIs (navigator in user-agent.ts, TextDecoder in mp4-tools.ts, atob in numeric-encoding-utils.ts) read through Otter's src/otter/env.ts via globalThis, so the package compiles without DOM types and runs in Workers / Node (ADR-007 §2).
utils/user-agent.ts: navigator read lazily (no top-level side effect).

src/demux/tsdemuxer.ts: remainderData = data.subarray(len) instead of new Uint8Array(data.buffer, len, data.buffer.byteLength - len). Upstream ignores the input view's byteOffset / byteLength, so a chunk that is a view into a larger buffer (Otter's streamed input) left garbage as the remainder: duplicated fragments and captions. Found in M3 (packages/pipeline/test/transmux.test.ts 'views'); candidate for an upstream fix.

Both merged as upstream wrote them; the other 15 files are identical at both commits, so the pin moves to b023c29. Upstream tsdemuxer.ts still has the remainder-view bug Otter fixes locally (localChanges).
